decisions.decision: Target TMOS/iRule behavior at version 17.5 only.
decisions.rationale: The user explicitly narrowed the compatibility target, avoiding cross-version ambiguity.

decisions.decision: Use the pinned bitwisecook/tcl-lsp catalog as the command/event source and layer semantic handlers over generated fallbacks.
decisions.rationale: This allows the full catalog to be consumed while concentrating fidelity work on high-value protocol behavior.

decisions.decision: Run all Python through uv with Python 3.13 or newer.
decisions.rationale: The user reported crashes from local/system Python; the verified host runtime is uv Python 3.13.9 and the container is Python 3.13.15.

decisions.decision: Build protocol fidelity incrementally using structured packet adapters plus bounded raw packet decoding.
decisions.rationale: This preserves the existing lightweight API while creating a path toward stateful emulation without requiring a full BIG-IP/vLab.

next_action: Resume with the three targeted SIP tests, fix the unset transport state and SIP::respond lifecycle termination, then rerun the full uv/3.13 host suite before touching docs or committing the SIP slice.
context_notes: The last clean commit is 7d49c35 feat: emulate MQTT message events. The current SIP work is intentionally WIP. One structured SIP lifecycle test passes; the raw TCP/UDP test errors on ::state::sip::transport, and the respond/discard test fails because SIP_REQUEST_DONE is still emitted. Do not describe the SIP slice as complete. Existing committed work covers catalog ingestion, HTTP/TLS/UDP/DNS, WebSocket, MQTT, API/MCP surfaces, and a uv-based Python 3.13 container, but the full true TMM emulation goal remains substantially incomplete.
